findings.title: Intel TDX Migration Trust Domain (MigTD) Advisory - INTEL-SA-01580
findings.summary_md: Intel published advisory INTEL-SA-01580 on November 10, 2026 covering 30 potential security vulnerabilities in the Intel TDX Migration Trust Domain (MigTD) reference software, including CVE-2026-61887, a critical missing-authentication flaw in the MigTD SPDM rebind implementation that may allow escalation of privilege, information disclosure, denial of service, and remote code execution. Intel is releasing reference software updates to mitigate the issues, including MigTD release v0.7.2. The advisory credits vic5589 via Intigriti for reporting CVE-2026-61467.

findings.title: AMD Graphics Vulnerabilities - November 2026 - AMD-SB-6028
findings.summary_md: AMD published security bulletin AMD-SB-6028 on November 10, 2026 covering 44 issues affecting Radeon and Instinct graphics products, including ten with a high severity score, with mitigation release dates ranging from January 2026 through August 2026 and some target releases planned for November 2026. The bulletin names external reporters including researchers from Meta Platforms, Seoul National University COMSEC Lab, and bug bounty researchers. It is one of the bulletins rolled up into AMD's November 2026 patch wave.

findings.title: AMD Manageability Vulnerabilities - AMD-SB-9031
findings.summary_md: AMD published security bulletin AMD-SB-9031 on November 9, 2026 describing insufficient access controls in AMD Management Console services that may expose stored management credentials, plus hard-coded credentials in AMD Management Console, AMD DASH CLI, and the AMD Manageability API that could allow unauthorized KVM sessions under specific provisioning conditions. The bulletin covers CVE-2026-70518 and CVE-2026-70519. It is part of the same November 2026 AMD advisory wave.
